scope: Public official pages only; no account access, supplier contact, quote request, signup, credentials or hosted test
recheck: Before candidate/edition/region/quantity/usage changes and immediately before any authorized purchase; listed prices are not checkout quotes

sources.title: DigitalOcean Basic Regular Droplets
sources.observation: Listed 4 GiB / 2 vCPU / 80 GiB USD 24 monthly cap; 8 GiB USD 48; hourly USD 0.03571 / 0.07143. Regional/account eligibility unverified.

sources.title: DigitalOcean Standard PostgreSQL
sources.observation: Listed minimum 4 GiB / 2 vCPU / 60 GiB USD 60.90/month, USD 0.09063/hour; extra storage/edition/nodes require separate quote.

sources.title: DigitalOcean backup pricing
sources.observation: Basic daily Droplet backups add 30 percent; distinct from independent DB/journal recovery.

sources.title: DigitalOcean registry pricing
sources.observation: Basic USD 5/month includes 5 GiB; Professional USD 20 includes 100 GiB; check retained release image size.

sources.title: Inngest pricing and execution metering
sources.observation: Pro starts USD 99/month with 1 million executions; Free includes 50000. Function runs and their steps are metered; account eligibility/add-ons unverified.

sources.title: Tailscale commercial access pricing
sources.observation: Standard lists USD 8/user/month; Personal is noncommercial. Two seats are a sizing assumption; billing term/features need confirmation.

sources.title: AWS KMS pricing
sources.observation: Customer-managed key USD 1/month; first two rotations add storage charges; requests and additional services billed separately. Model takes no free-tier credits.

sources.title: AWS S3 pricing dimensions
sources.observation: Model uses unquoted allowances for bytes including versions, requests, storage classes, replication, retrieval and transfer; no selected-region per-unit quote.

sources.title: GitHub Actions billing
sources.observation: Runner, artifact/cache/image storage and account allowances must be reconciled; no account allowance or credit assumed.

sources.title: Resend pricing
sources.observation: No-send scope has no ESP subscription or external sends; later provider acceptance/sending requires separate tier/usage quote, domain review and authorization.

sources.title: DigitalOcean PostgreSQL limits
sources.observation: Standard new-cluster growth/node restrictions and restricted administrator powers remain compatibility conditions, not accepted hosting.
